# Wagner Reese, LLP

> Indianapolis-based personal injury law firm specializing in trial litigation, medical malpractice, wrongful death, and product liability cases since 1997.

Wagner Reese, LLP is a prominent Indianapolis personal injury firm founded by Stephen Wagner and Jason Reese, both recognized as Super Lawyers. The firm handles complex litigation matters including medical malpractice, birth injuries, wrongful death, mass torts, and product liability cases. The team includes multiple Indiana Super Lawyers and trial specialists with decades of combined experience.

- Product Liability
